reporting_note: One cumulative record across 17, 24 and 31 October 2026. The older 17/24 October entries are retrospective reconstructions of model race leaders, while 31 October entries are original published reviewed Top 15 ranks. These distinct selection methodologies share one outcome ledger but do not establish one comparable out-of-sample model hit rate or statistically calibrated win probabilities. Scratchings are excluded from the denominator.

sources.method: Previously reconstructed model rankings; not an independent pre-race lock.
